# AggregateError.FlattenedErrors property

Gets all leaf errors from the entire error tree, recursively flattened.

Unlike [`Errors`](./Errors.md), this recursively descends into nested [`AggregateError`](../AggregateError.md) instances and returns only non-aggregate errors. Equivalent to `Flatten().Errors` but without allocation when the error tree is already flat.

```csharp
public IReadOnlyList<Error> FlattenedErrors { get; }
```
